$comment: The environment the migrations need in order to run, declared once and consumed by both repos.
This file exists because migration 020 was mergeable and green here while breaking every branch
in paul-explore. Nothing in this repo ran migrations, so the requirement it added was only
discovered by the frontend workflow, which is the one place nobody looks when reviewing an API
Values are throwaway and deliberately obvious. They protect nothing: the database they run
against is created empty and thrown away, and a fake-looking value cannot be mistaken for a real
secret. Never put a real credential in here.
Adding a migration that needs a new variable? The migrations CI job fails until it is declared
here. Once it is, paul-explore picks it up automatically, because it runs the same script against

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.why: Migration 020 encrypts the stored Google OAuth tokens through utils/tokenCrypto, which refuses to run without a key. Must be a valid 32-byte hex string.
